result.reason: The clause largely reaches the preferred position by providing affiliate coverage, third-party IP, legal breach, gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct indemnities, standard defense procedures, and an uncapped indemnity. However, its security coverage is limited to unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company Confidential Information, which may not cover all Contractor-caused data breaches involving personal data, systems, or other protected data. No Company indemnity is added, which is no broader than the permitted position. The drafting unnecessarily relocates the existing warranty, leaves duplicate/out-of-order subsection numbering, and references a nonexistent Section 7(b), so it is not minimal or fully polished, although unrelated commercial intent is substantively preserved.
